author: JDeiTwo
body: So, Its been a month I think since I posted my last Infraction of this unfarily banned spider hack ban. I didn't get appealed because you have a evidence video of me walking up some stairs. Personally I didn't see anything bad at the stair walking evidence video, but you still think that I could use some spider hack. I still don't really know what spider hack is, but I do know that I am not capable of any kind of a hack/cheat. Also I wouldn't hack, because where would the fun be if I was ridiculously OP (overpowered) and no one would stand against me. So I don't think that you are gonna appeal me what so ever, but you should note my points.
